module.storage_smart.name: Drive health (SMART)
module.storage_smart.desc: NVMe and ATA/SATA drive health: verdict, temperature, wear, power-on hours and the full SMART attribute table with a verdict for every attribute. Reading requires administrator rights (physical drive handle).
module.storage_smart.ata.col.name: Attribute
module.storage_smart.warn.spare: Available spare fell below the threshold — the media is nearly exhausted.
module.storage_smart.warn.temperature: The controller reports a temperature threshold violation.
module.storage_smart.warn.reliability: The controller reports degraded reliability — copy your data.
module.storage_smart.warn.read_only: The media is read-only — move the data immediately.
module.storage_smart.warn.volatile_backu: Volatile memory backup failed — recent writes may be lost.
module.storage_smart.warn.persistent_rea: The controller's persistent memory is read-only.
module.storage_smart.note.elevation: Without administrator rights Windows does not expose physical drives, so SMART is unavailable. Run the program as administrator.
module.storage_smart.note.denied: Access to the physical drive was denied. Run the program as administrator.
module.storage_smart.note.unavailable: This drive does not expose SMART through its bus or controller.
module.storage_smart.note.failed: Reading SMART failed — details are in the JSON report.
module.storage_smart.note.none: The system reports no physical drives.
module.storage_smart.note.no_media: The drive has no media inserted — there is nothing to read.
module.storage_smart.note.bridge: Drives behind a USB bridge or RAID controller often do not pass SMART through — that is a hardware limitation, not a program error.
module.storage_smart.note.threshold_exce: At least one attribute exceeded its vendor threshold — this is a pre-failure state.
module.storage_smart.note.counters: Raw error counters are non-zero — check attributes 5, 10, 184, 187, 188, 196, 197, 198 and 199.
module.storage_bench.name: Drive speed (benchmark)
module.storage_bench.desc: Sequential surface read with an HD Tune-style speed map: minimum, average and maximum throughput, random 4K access time, IOPS and a list of unreadable blocks. The test only reads data and requires administrator rights (physical drive handle); start it from the module panel.
module.storage_bench.status.label: Test result
module.storage_bench.note.idle: Pick a drive and range in the panel above, then start the test with the Start button.
module.storage_bench.note.running: Test in progress. You can stop it with the Cancel button — the partial result is kept.
module.storage_bench.note.readonly: The test only reads — it never writes to or modifies data on the drive.
module.storage_bench.note.whole_disk: The test always samples the whole surface: the sample count comes from the time limit, not the drive size, so 2 TB and 120 GB take the same time.
module.storage_bench.note.time_limit: The time limit ran out before the end of the surface — the map covers only the part that was read. Raise the limit to measure the whole drive.
module.storage_bench.note.elevation: Without administrator rights Windows does not expose the physical drive — the test will fail with access denied. Run the program as administrator.
module.storage_bench.note.no_drives: The system reports no physical drives — there is nothing to test.
module.storage_bench.note.cancelled: The test was cancelled by the user — the data below covers only the part that was read.
module.storage_bench.note.read_errors: At least one block could not be read. This may be a bad sector — check SMART and back up the data.
module.storage_bench.note.incomplete: The test stopped before the end of the range — the result is partial.
module.storage_bench.note.failed: The test did not start or was stopped by a device error.
module.storage_bench.note.wmi: The drive list could not be read from WMI — the model name may be unknown.
